ashe.name: ONS Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE)
ashe.notes: Gross annual pay percentiles by occupation. Some cells are suppressed for reliability; the pipeline must handle blanks.

soc2020.name: Standard Occupational Classification 2020
soc2020.notes: Use the ONS SOC 2020 search/coding tool to assign each career a 4-digit unit group.

freyOsborne.name: The Future of Employment: How Susceptible Are Jobs to Computerisation?
freyOsborne.authors: Frey, C. B. and Osborne, M. A.
freyOsborne.publication: Technological Forecasting and Social Change, vol. 114, pp. 254-280
freyOsborne.notes: Per-occupation probability of computerisation, keyed to US SOC. Cross-walk to UK SOC 2020 is approximate and must be labelled as such.

oecd.name: Automation, skills use and training
oecd.publication: OECD Social, Employment and Migration Working Papers No. 202
oecd.notes: Task-based automation risk. More conservative than Frey-Osborne; useful as a cross-check.

pwc.name: Will robots really steal our jobs?
pwc.notes: UK-focused automation exposure by sector and wave; useful for the UK cross-walk.

hmrc.name: Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances; National Insurance rates
hmrc.notes: 2026/27 England thresholds. Verified. Update each tax year.
